column1: # The files the Fly image downloads at build time, pinned (decision 084).
#   name    sha256    upstream URL(s), nearest first
# fly/fetch.sh fetches a file by name: from our own mirror first
# (https://salishsea.io/downloads/<sha256>, the salishsea-io-downloads bucket), then
# from each upstream URL, and uses the first whose bytes match the sha256. So the
# image build does not depend on a third-party host being up and trusted (#727:
# Racket's own host redirected to a mirror whose certificate Debian doesn't trust),
# and the mirror cannot change what gets installed. scripts/downloads/mirror.sh puts
# every file here into the bucket.
# To move a pin: change the sha256 and the URL here, run scripts/downloads/mirror.sh,
# and deploy. A sha256 the bucket doesn't hold falls back to upstream, so the mirror
# step can also follow the deploy; it just isn't a mirror until then.
# Racket is not here: Stelis installs its own (its scripts/install-racket.sh and
# racket-downloads.tsv, the same format as this file, at the commit fly/stelis-commit
# pins), with this mirror first. mirror.sh reads that file too, so the bucket holds
# the Racket that commit installs.
duckdb
caddy
litestream
supercronic
